name: paperweight
description: Local-first deadline tracker for paperwork, assignments and life admin. Add things in one sentence; Paperweight reminds you.
long_description:
Paperweight keeps track of deadlines for paperwork, assignments, payments, appointments and plans with friends, entirely on your computer. Tell Claude about a form or a bill and it is tracked, with its checklist of what's needed and the steps to get it done. The Paperweight desktop app (installed separately) sends the reminders, so you never have to remember to open anything.

No accounts, no cloud, no network traffic: the server reads and writes a local SQLite database shared with the desktop app.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Track a new deadline, with its steps and what's needed, in one call.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Change an item: dates, details, steps and checklist.

tools.name: complete_item
tools.description: Mark an item done; repeating items get their next occurrence.

tools.name: snooze_item
tools.description: Silence an item's reminders until a time, without moving the deadline.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Move an item to the archive (restorable for 30 days).

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Find items by status, kind, date range and text.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: What's overdue, due today and due this week, in priority order.

tools.name: plan_week
tools.description: Suggest when to work on each item using the weekly routine.
